description:
B. napus phenotypes of five published populations held by BnIR: 525 ERANET-ASSYST inbred lines (Bus et al.
2011: agronomy, seed quality, seedling traits), 991 resequenced accessions (Wu et al. 2019: flowering time, seed oil,
trichomes), 210 accessions (Song et al. 2020: flowering time), 505 inbred lines (Tang et al. 2021: cadmium,
salt, salt-alkali and low-phosphorus stress, agronomic traits, seed phytate) and leaf/root glucosinolate profiles
(Kittipol et al. 2019). trait: words (e.g. 'flowering', 'oil content', 'glucosinolate', 'salt'); line: a cultivar
or accession name or BnIR sample ID (e.g. 'Westar', 'Darmor', 'R4155'); population: Bus2011_525, Wu2019_991,
Song2020_210, Tang2021_505 or Kittipol2019_GSL. For a trait: matching trait-environment records with n, mean and
range, and the highest and lowest lines; for a line: its values for every trait. Values are as published per
environment, not adjusted across studies: compare lines within one trait record.
name: bnapus_phenotypes
